newsitem.title: INDIA: Chinese president to visit India.
newsitem.headline: Chinese president to visit India.

text.p: Chinese President Jiang Zemin will begin a three-day state visit to India on November 28, the foreign ministry announced on Tuesday.

Jiang will hold meetings with Indian President Shankar Dayal Sharma, Vice-President K.R. Narayanan, Prime Minister H.D. Deve Gowda, and other senior officials, the foreign ministry said in a statement.
He will also meet leading industrialists and businessmen, it added.
